applications.title: Discord Moderator
applications.summary: Help keep the Yeeps Channel + Yeeps Don’t Sleep Discord a fun, welcoming place to hang out and watch together.

intro.p: Help keep the Yeeps Channel + Yeeps Don’t Sleep Discord a fun, welcoming place to hang out and watch together.

list: Enforce the server rules fairly and consistently
Handle warnings, timeouts and bans with our moderation bot
Answer questions and help members who ask for help
Check in on reports and tickets
Work with the rest of the team in the staff channels
You’re active on Discord, and you can tell us roughly when
You’re calm, fair and patient, even when people aren’t
You’ve read the server rules and agree with them
You can keep staff conversations private
You’re comfortable learning new tools, since we use a custom moderation bot

intro.p: New moderators start with limited permissions and earn more over time. Our team has three tiers: Jr Mod, Mod and Sr Mod. You’ll get a mod guide that covers every rule and every bot command you can use.
Every application is read by the team, and we’ll message you on Discord with an answer, so keep your DMs open.
